sentences.text:
This is first application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of temporary bail in connection with Crime No.411/2020 registered at Police Station Kanadiya, Distt.
Indore (M.P.) under Sections 420, 467, 468 of IPC.
The present application is for grant of temporary bail on the ground of advance stage of pregnancy of the wife of the applicant.
It is further submitted that there is no male member in the family to look after his wife.
Counsel for State, on verification, submits that the wife of the applicant is having nine months pregnancy and the delivery may take any time in this month.

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid, the application for grant of temporary bail is allowed.

Applicant shall be released on temporary bail for a period of 45 days from the date of his release upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.

The applicant shall surrender immediately after expiration of 45 days from the date of his release failing which the trial court shall take appropriate steps for securing his arrest in accordance with law.

The prison authorities are also requested to ensure compliance with the order passed by the Supreme Court IN RE : CONTAGION OF COVID 19 VIRUS IN PRISONS in SUO MOTU "W.P. (C)
No.1/2020" and ensure that the applicant is examined by the jail doctor before release.

If the applicant shows symptoms of COVID-19, the doctor shall forthwith direct applicant to be produced before the appropriate hospital designated for the detection and treatment of COVID-19 patients.
If the doctor is of the opinion that the applicant is not affected with the virus, the jail authorities shall ensure transportation from the jail till the place of residence.
A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.
